summary: Follow-ups System Enhancement Testing Complete - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend (22/22), Frontend UI fully functional. Dashboard widget shows today's follow-ups with client name, entity type badge, overdue indicators, and 'View all' link. Follow-ups page has detail view with history, add update, close, schedule-next, and reassign (for managers). Stage filter shows all 9 funnel stages. Escalations visible for managers.

issues: Console shows 'WebSocket error: Event' messages - not affecting functionality but should be investigated

critical_code_review_comments: Backend follow_ups.py properly implements all endpoints: create, list, dashboard/today, escalations, detail, update, close, schedule-next, reassign
Frontend FollowUps.js correctly renders summary cards, escalations alert, detail dialog with history, action buttons
TodayFollowUpsWidget properly fetches /api/follow-ups/dashboard/today and shows items with overdue indicators
Reassign endpoint correctly transfers ownership across all funnel stages when transfer_all_stages=true
Entity types validated against 9 valid stages: lead, meeting, pricing_plan, sow, quotation, agreement, payment, kickoff, project
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test follow-ups via backend tests: TEST_FollowUpSystem Corp (lead), TEST_Meeting Stage Client (meeting), TEST_Overdue Escalation Client (pricing_plan - 3 days overdue for escalation testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Follow-ups system fully functional with dedicated collection. Dashboard widget shows on admin dashboard when total > 0. Escalation count shows items overdue by 2+ days. All CRUD operations, schedule-next, and reassign working. WebSocket console errors visible but not affecting functionality.
